bio: Rosie is a bustling yet cosy establishment where foodies can indulge uninterrupted from noon. A love of wine pervades the place and music fills the air – the record player spins nostalgic tunes regularly. From shrimp croquettes to Jerusalem artichoke with labneh or a no-nonsense meat or fish dish: the international menu has something for everyone. This straightforward cuisine makes the most of the versatility of vegetables. Reservations are recommended!...
